aboutPage.title: Our philosophy
aboutPage.intro: is a company focused on property and investment opportunities in northern Albania, mainly in Tale, Shëngjin and Kunë — properties near the Adriatic coast, suited to personal use as well as residential, tourism and commercial development and long-term investment.
aboutPage.strengthTitle: A direct owner, not an intermediary.
aboutPage.strengthText: Wilson's key strength is its direct relationship with the property. Wilson directly owns the properties it offers, which cuts out intermediaries and makes the process clearer, more transparent and safer for the buyer — with better knowledge of the property, its documents and its context.
aboutPage.missionHeading: A property is not just an area for sale, but an opportunity with potential.
aboutPage.missionText: We identify and present properties with long-term value, weighing location, closeness to the sea, development potential and a safe process.
aboutPage.visionHeading: An investment portfolio with long-term impact.
aboutPage.visionText: Known for quality, reliability and concrete results in every area where Wilson is present.
